findings.reason: setProjectTrust ignores the new boolean result of setTrustFlag and emits the consent-changed event even when nothing was written (unknown project id, entry gone, no view path). setSkillUsesConfirmation does the opposite: for the same case its doc says 'nothing written and nothing invalidated'. The extra invalidation does no harm, but the two consent writers now behave differently. Gate the emit the same way: `if (this.setTrustFlag(...)) this.emitConsentChanged(ws, id);`.
